stage0017_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$n
「So that's going to be our base of operations
　from now on... $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, huh」

stage0017_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It really looks the part...
　It's lovely」

stage0017_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ボス$$
「So Miss $$スズネ$$ likes stuff like that, huh」

stage0017_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$スズネ$$
「In myths and legends all over the world,
　dragons carry great meaning」

stage0017_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Using it as a symbol must be
　that base's commander, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$,
　is simply being romantic」

stage0017_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「Heh... who knew that cool, composed
　$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$ had a taste like that」

stage0017_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Well, it's only natural, isn't it.
　He acts cool, but underneath he's
　the hot-blooded boss of Team D」

stage0017_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Don't call people steamed buns or hotpot tofu」

stage0017_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$くらら$$
「It's fine, isn't it.
　It's not a bad turn of phrase, I think」

stage0017_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「I agree.
　'Steamed Bun' is so much cuter than
　a scary callsign like 'Danger 1'」

stage0017_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「While we're at it, let's add
　'Hate the sin, love the meat bun'」

stage0017_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Wonderful, $$ジョニー$$!
　You've got a sense of humor too!」

stage0017_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Whoa... if $$エイーダ$$'s fans saw this,
　they'd cry out of pure jealousy」

stage0017_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$さやか$$
「But is it really okay, $$エイーダ$$?
　Going on hiatus as an idol...」

stage0017_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「...It's a decision I struggled with.
　I do think cheering up many people
　through my songs matters too, but...」

stage0017_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「I'll leave that side to $$ランカ$$ and
　$$シェリル$$. My stage is the Dancouga...
　and my song is the fight for peace」

stage0017_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's passionate.
　That's Team Steamed Bun for you」

stage0017_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$葵$$
「That was a joke, $$甲児$$.
　Team D still fits us better after all」

stage0017_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$葵$$
「Well then, let's head to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.
　There's something we need
　$n and Miss $$スズネ$$ to do」

stage0017_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$甲児$$
「What is it?
　If it's heavy lifting, we'll all help」

stage0017_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$朔哉$$
「N, no... it's nothing...
　Just got a little dizzy for a second...」

stage0017_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「But it's strange...
　all five of Team D getting a headache at once」

stage0017_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Having our minds sync up
　in a place like this isn't fun」

stage0017_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$葵$$
「Maybe we should get counseling too,
　along with $n and the others...」

stage0017_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text: $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room

stage0017_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text: $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room

stage0017_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text: $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room

stage0017_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text: ～ $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room ～

stage0017_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Welcome, Director $$大塚$$.
　Thank you for taking the trouble to come」

stage0017_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$大塚$$
「Never mind that, never mind that.
　I wanted to go over the data the
　Crusher Team gathered right away anyway」

stage0017_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$大塚$$
「So $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ was observing it too...
　What do you make of it?」

stage0017_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「It's been a while, Director $$大塚$$」

stage0017_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$大塚$$
「Oh, good to see you're doing well too」

stage0017_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「Thank you for showing such concern
　even for an inorganic intelligence like me」

stage0017_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$大塚$$
「You're less $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$'s main
　computer than a comrade we rely on」

stage0017_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$大塚$$
「Now then, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$... let's hear your view」

stage0017_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「To give my conclusion first,
　the black hole that formed roughly 500
　light-years from Earth is unnatural」

stage0017_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「The method relies on Fold wave
　observation, so there's some uncertainty,
　but the hole seems to appear and vanish repeatedly」

stage0017_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「Even I've never seen a phenomenon like this」

stage0017_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$大塚$$
「Coming from you, who's gathered all
　the universe's knowledge, we're stumped」

stage0017_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「No... I'm not all-powerful either.
　This universe still holds a number of
　mysteries yet to be solved」

stage0017_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「I do retain fragments of information
　about them, but this incident
　appears to be something else entirely」

stage0017_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$大塚$$
「So, what about the effect this
　black hole will have on our solar system?」

stage0017_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「Based on the data the Crusher Team
　brought back and my own observations,
　I can only say it's unknown」

stage0017_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$田中司令$$
「What...!
　For $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ to hedge like that...!」

stage0017_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
ＷＩＬＬ
「I'm sorry.
　For me as well, this phenomenon
　can only be called unknown」

stage0017_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We'll treat this as a matter of caution
　and keep observing to gather all we can」

stage0017_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$大塚$$
「Hm...
　All we can do is look up and pray nothing happens...」

stage0017_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$セイミー$$
「...So, how did everyone's checkups go?」

stage0017_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$葵$$
「Everyone's fine, no abnormalities.
　They said the headaches must be a fluke...」

stage0017_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$セイミー$$
「That's the obvious result.
　I wouldn't believe it if you told me
　people who pilot that hard were sick」

stage0017_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You really say it like it is, $$セイミー$$」

stage0017_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Get ready, $$朔哉$$.
　I'll be tagging along as your mechanic from now on」

stage0017_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$セイミー$$
「If you put a scratch on the Dancouga Nova,
　you'll be punished for every bit of it」

stage0017_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Isn't a mechanic usually the type
　to say it's fine as long as you're
　safe, even if the machine gets scratched...」

stage0017_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Ahaha... I believe you lot are the
　kind who wouldn't die even if killed」

stage0017_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But I'm glad.
　That everyone's healthy」

stage0017_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah...
　Since we're at it, maybe I'll get a checkup too...」

stage0017_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「...Well... how do I put it, well...」

stage0017_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Let me explain in his place.
　The President's been worrying that he
　hasn't grown much taller these past months」

stage0017_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But I'm... supposed to be growing fast now!
　And yet my height's barely changed in four months!」

stage0017_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「You'll be fine, $$ワッ太$$.
　You eat that much food and snacks every day」

stage0017_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$柿小路$$
「$$ジョニー$$'s right.
　Your body is simply resting for now,
　and you'll shoot right up after this」

stage0017_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$木下$$
「That's right.
　You'll spring right up, spring up!」

stage0017_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$厚井$$
「Somehow, once the section chief cheers you up,
　worrying about it starts to feel silly...」

stage0017_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's true.
　But I think worrying about this kind
　of thing is actually bad for your body」

stage0017_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You haven't changed much either, $$正太郎$$」

stage0017_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「T, that's not true...!
　I'm growing bit by bit!」

stage0017_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So, what are $n and Miss $$スズネ$$ up to?」

stage0017_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$朔哉$$
「It's Ruu-Ruu's counseling.
　Until just a little while ago, they
　had nothing to do with fighting at all」

stage0017_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's why she looks after their mental care」

stage0017_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, during the
　$$破界事変$$, I was made to get it too」

stage0017_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$竜馬$$
「In the end, I made up some excuse and skipped it」

stage0017_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「In $$竜馬$$'s case, moving your body
　seems like it'd blow your worries away」

stage0017_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Said it, $$ワッ太$$!
　Then I'll blow away your height worries
　too, with some training from me!」

stage0017_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Cut it out!
　That kind of thing's more $$甲児$$'s
　or $n's speed, they'd love it!」

stage0017_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, $n...
　seems to be fighting to get stronger」

stage0017_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$葵$$
「Or so I hear, but stronger for what?」

stage0017_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「No one seems to have heard the reason though...」

stage0017_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right...
　Even when I ask, they won't tell me」

stage0017_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks for your hard work, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　Where's $n...?」

stage0017_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It seems it'll take a bit longer.
　I was waiting outside the counseling
　room after my own session ended, but...」

stage0017_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ボス$$
「They've got some twisted pride, that one.
　If Miss $$スズネ$$ asked me questions,
　I'd confess to stuff I never even did」

stage0017_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's leave it to $$ルゥ$$ for now.
　She's a professional, so I'm sure
　she'll open up $n's heart」

stage0017_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Everyone, an emergency has occurred.
　A Mechabeast army has appeared in Atami」

stage0017_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「The Crusher Team is heading there from
　Izu, but $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ will also launch」

stage0017_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Please board your machines
　and prepare to sortie」

stage0017_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブロッケン$$, damn him!
　Showing up again without learning his lesson!」

stage0017_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Targeting Atami means...
　he means to vent his old grudge on
　$$くろがね屋$$'s proprietress, Tsubasa...!」

stage0017_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$n
「I don't know what they're after,
　but Atami has a lot of tourists」

stage0017_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$甲児$$
「$n's right...!
　We can't let uninvolved people get
　dragged into $$ブロッケン$$'s twisted grudge!」

stage0017_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　We have to back up $$タケル$$ and the others!」

stage0017_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「Before we sortie, I have a bit
　to talk about regarding $n...」

stage0017_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Did something happen in the counseling?」

stage0017_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「As you just heard,
　$n shows strong resistance whenever
　an uninvolved person's life is put at risk」

stage0017_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...I noticed it too.
　It's probably related to their father
　and older sister, who died in an accident...」

stage0017_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「I couldn't get specifics about it.
　It seems that matter has taken root
　in the deepest part of them」

stage0017_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「But when I touched on it,
　$n's eyes were filled with intense
　anger and sorrow」

stage0017_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「The eyes of one who lost something and swore revenge.」

stage0017_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... I'm sure that in the battles
　to come, $n will show what's in their heart」

stage0017_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「Please be careful.
　Too strong a rage can end up destroying
　both yourself and everyone around you」

stage0017_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Understood, $$ルゥ$$.
　I may not be much help, but I intend
　to be their partner」

stage0017_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$スズネ$$
「When that time comes,
　I will surely protect $n's heart.
　...Well, I'll get going too」

stage0017_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「There's something about you that concerns me too...」

stage0017_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$葵$$
「So, $$ロゼ$$ came to warn Earth
　about the threat of a black hole, huh」

stage0017_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Yes...
　Actually, several stars in the galaxy have
　been getting swallowed by black holes」

stage0017_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You mean that black hole is coming
　near Earth too!?」

stage0017_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$タケル$$
「That won't happen, $$ワッ太$$.
　Black holes are generally formed when
　a giant star explodes」

stage0017_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「And even the closest star to Earth
　is about four light years away」

stage0017_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Four light years means it'd take four years
　to get there even at light speed, right?」

stage0017_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Even I know that much.
　Takeo General Company does anything in space」

stage0017_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ナオト$$
「So, we teamed up with the Frontier fleet,
　and used Fold Wave observation tech
　to survey the stars near Earth」

stage0017_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アキラ$$
「For now, we found what looks like a black
　hole 500 light years from Earth, but if
　it's that far, it won't affect Earth」

stage0017_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$n
「So they're members of the Crusher Team,
　under Far East Branch Director $$大塚$$...」

stage0017_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$タケル$$
「Come to think of it, I haven't introduced myself.」

stage0017_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
Takeru
「I'm $$明神タケル$$.
　My name out in space is Mars」

stage0017_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'm not from Earth.
　I'm from planet Gishin, and got the name Mars there」

stage0017_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
Takeru
「When I was little, I was sent to Earth
　from planet Gishin, and there my father
　and mother took me in and named me $$明神タケル$$」

stage0017_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Mr. $$タケル$$'s the pilot of $$ゴッドマーズ$$,
　and he's a seriously amazing psychic too!」

stage0017_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$タケル$$
「I intend to use $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and my psychic
　powers for the peace of the universe.
　Let's get along from now on」

stage0017_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Heh... Seems you're a little thrown off
　by Mars's straightforwardness」

stage0017_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「I'm $$ロゼ$$.
　I'm not from Earth either, but I'm helping
　Mars, who fights for peace」

stage0017_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Why don't you explain it to $n, $$朔哉$$?
　Bitterness and all」

stage0017_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Hey, you!
　You want to make me the punchline that bad!?」

stage0017_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$木下$$
「That's right.
　Being a lovable character is a happy thing」

stage0017_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So I'm... on this team, huh...」

stage0017_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ナオト$$
「Sounds like you've got it rough, $$朔哉$$」

stage0017_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
Naoto
「I'm $$伊集院ナオト$$.
　I handle attacks aboard the $$コスモクラッシャー$$」

stage0017_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
Akira
「I'm $$木曽アキラ$$. I handle piloting」

stage0017_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
Mika
「I'm $$日向ミカ$$. I handle comms」

stage0017_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
Kenji
「And I'm $$飛鳥ケンジ$$, captain of the
　$$コスモクラッシャー$$ team」

stage0017_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I've heard about you from Director $$大塚$$.
　Nice to formally meet you」

stage0017_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's reassuring that the Crusher Team
　joined us, but that word 'Demon King' the
　psychic mentioned worries me」

stage0017_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$タケル$$, is there no chance 《$$ズール$$》 has been revived?」

stage0017_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$タケル$$
「...While I was fighting them,
　I sensed a huge presence behind them」

stage0017_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$タケル$$
「It was huge, dark, and terrifying,
　but it wasn't $$ズール$$」

stage0017_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$タケル$$
「I don't know how to put it either,
　but in a word, I felt... the universe」

stage0017_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$朔哉$$
「No use thinking about stuff we don't get.
　If they're coming to attack us,
　we'll just meet them head on」

stage0017_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ボス$$
「That's the stuff, $$朔哉$$!
　That kind of forceful logic!」

stage0017_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$木下$$
「Yes!
　That's exactly the feel of it!」

stage0017_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$朔哉$$
「...Being praised by you two doesn't help...」

stage0017_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$タケル$$
「But I think $$朔哉$$'s right too.
　That's a lot better than being
　crushed by anxiety」

stage0017_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$葵$$
「I agree with $$タケル$$ too.
　I like to stay stress free mentally」

stage0017_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$甲児$$
「True enough.
　'Bring it on' suits us better」

stage0017_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$朔哉$$
「The difference in how $$タケル$$ and I get treated...」

stage0017_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Different personalities.
　But you're the Rhino. I thought
　you'd have a thicker skin」

stage0017_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「$$ジョニー$$, you're so sharp!」

stage0017_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$朔哉$$
「...Just do whatever you want with me...」

stage0017_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「About today's alien attack, it seems
　$$大塚$$ will report to HQ and plan a response」

stage0017_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But, is this really okay...?
　Space is getting kind of hectic too,
　and we're stuck in Tokyo this whole time...」

stage0017_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Since we beat the terrorist unit,
　I think we should help other regions now...」

stage0017_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Seems Director $$大塚$$ has a plan for that.
　Let's follow it for now」

stage0017_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$甲児$$
「What's wrong, $n?
　Did it catch your occult-loving antenna?」

stage0017_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No need to worry, $n.
　Whatever this Demon King is, we've got
　this many Super Robots gathered」

stage0017_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$n
「...But there are forces in this world beyond human understanding...」

stage0017_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What in the world is going on...?」

stage0017_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$n
「...Sorry, $$ワッ太$$.
　You went out of your way to cheer me up too」

stage0017_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm not bothered by it.
　...But, not to sound like Mr. $$木下$$,
　sometimes it's easier to just relax」

stage0017_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$n...
　I knew it. You're hiding something...）

stage0017_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Damn $$ブロッケン$$, good for nothing but stalling.」

stage0017_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「No matter.
　They served their bare minimum purpose」

stage0017_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Once he learns the strength of Kouji
　Kabuto and his comrades, the Demon King will act」

stage0017_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Heh... For the Demon King to set their
　eyes on Earth is more than I hoped for」

stage0017_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「If anything, it's only natural.
　This is the edge of causality... the promised land」

stage0017_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「All is inevitable...
　...Have they noticed that too, I wonder...?」

stage0017_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Who's to say...
　In this situation, it could go either way」

stage0017_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「But the wind is blowing our way.
　In time, the stars' cycle will meet its moment」

stage0017_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Heh... Before then, if I get the chance,
　I'd like to pay my nemesis a visit」

stage0017_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Then, when that thing appears...」

stage0017_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「And when that time comes...」

stage0017_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Yes... Let us offer up our lives」

stage0017_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$タケル$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've heard about you from $$甲児$$ and the others」

stage0017_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You haven't misused your powers, right?
　Like seeing through girls' clothes with
　clairvoyance, or reading minds for secrets...」

stage0017_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$タケル$$
「I haven't done anything like that!」

stage0017_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I wonder about that...
　Hero of justice or not, you're still a teenage boy...」

stage0017_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$タケル$$
「I've never used my powers that way!
　I swear it on $$マーグ#pilot$$, my brother!」

stage0017_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Then I'll trust you.
　I hear you're very sincere, after all」

stage0017_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When you smile like that,
　it makes me embarrassed for jumping to
　such a low-minded suspicion. I'm sorry」

stage0017_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't worry about it, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Let's get along from here on」

stage0017_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Likewise.
　I hope we can build a good relationship」

stage0017_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, I'll get back to my main business.
　Fired up today too... business, business!」
